name: aspirecures-weekly-research
description: Weekly research pipeline for AspireCURES: collect, curate, render, commit disease pages (two-agent split)

preparer.description: Collects from Europe PMC + PubMed + ClinicalTrials.gov + ISRCTN, applies Claude curation gate, emits JSON report

commit_agent.description: Consumes JSON report, renders 9 disease pages, validates against lint-feed.pl and verify.sh, commits and pushes
commit_agent.trigger: cronjob delivery -> user response in chat

output_format: JSON report at .hermes/cron/active/aspirecures-research-report.json, consumed by commit agent
key_guardrails: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY needed — the agent IS the model using its own Claude judgments for the curation gate
Append-only data merges with date-churn signature comparison
Skip and record if credentials unavailable (Europe PMC API key is free, PubMed is free)
Never commit unverified output — check lint-feed.pl and verify.sh before committing
If git push fails (no credentials/no network), commit locally and record push_error in report
If External API call fails (rate limit, timeout), skip that source and record as unverified — do not fabricate data
guardrails: Two-agent split: preparer runs autonomously (no_agent=false, LLM-driven), commit agent triggered by user response
Preparer emits JSON report only — does NOT commit or push
Commit agent validates against lint-feed.pl and verify.sh before any git operations
Append-only merge semantics — existing data entries KEPT, new entries added, never removed
Date churn prevention — signature comparison (canonical JSON excluding 'generated' + unrendered fields) before bumping date stamps
Dedup by PMID AND DOI (and normalized title for cross-registry) — same paper from multiple DBs = one entry
Safe-fail per entity — failed entity skipped, existing data untouched
Spend caps known and enforced — token budget + call budget limits embedded in agent context
Country normalization via COUNTRY_FIX map applied to all trial locations
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 set in environment — no interactive git prompts
stale execution state (failure_streak > 0) should be cleared before re-firing
Model pinned to prevent drift-skip: provider=claude, model=claude-sonnet-4-20250514
cron_mode approval required for terminal commands — set approvals.cron_mode: approve for git push operations
notes: This job uses LLM-driven agents (no_agent=false) for the two-agent split pattern. The preparer agent substitutes its own Claude judgments for the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-gated curation step in the repo's CI pipeline. The commit agent is a human-triggered follow-up that consumes the report. See autonomous-repo-cronjob skill for the full pattern.
